recognize_zh: 胸部 X 光（AP 位）可見兩側多數肋骨前端明顯膨大、骨小樑粗糙，右側較明顯，縱膈與脊椎旁陰影增寬，是無效造血導致的髓外造血與骨髓腔擴張。
features: Frontal (AP) chest radiograph of a young adult male
Marked expansion of the anterior/sternal ends of multiple ribs bilaterally, more prominent on the right
Coarse, widened rib contours consistent with marrow cavity expansion
No definite focal consolidation assessable at this resolution
describe_en: This is not a microscopic image but an AP chest radiograph. It shows expansion of the anterior ends of almost all ribs, more pronounced on the right, with coarse widened rib contours, and widening of the paravertebral soft tissue shadow. These changes reflect marrow hyperplasia and extramedullary hematopoiesis driven by chronic ineffective erythropoiesis. In a splenectomized patient with hemoglobin E/beta-thalassemia, findings are consistent with extramedullary hematopoiesis; paravertebral masses warrant MRI to exclude spinal cord compression.

ddx.vs: Neurogenic tumors are usually solitary and lack diffuse rib expansion, whereas extramedullary hematopoiesis presents as bilateral paravertebral masses with widened ribs in a patient with chronic hemolysis.
Lymphoma causes anterior/middle mediastinal nodal masses without generalized expansion of the ribs.

ddx.dx: Multiple myeloma or metastatic bone disease
ddx.vs: These produce lytic, destructive rib lesions rather than smooth diffuse expansion with a coarse trabecular pattern.
